declaration_name: Name and Address of Manufacturer / Packer
description: Every package shall bear the name and complete address of the manufacturer, or where the manufacturer is not the packer, the name and address of the manufacturer and packer.
legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(a) read with Rule 6(1)(ab), Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
official_legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(a) read with Rule 6(1)(ab), Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (as amended 2022/2023)
english_text: Every package shall bear the name and complete address of the manufacturer, or where the manufacturer is not the packer, the name and address of the manufacturer and packer.
hindi_text_snippet: प्रत्येक पैकेज पर निर्माता या पैकर का पूरा नाम और पता लिखा होना अनिवार्य है।
applicability_notes: Applicable to all pre-packaged commodities across food, cosmetics, garments, electronics, medical devices, and general merchandise.

declaration_name: Generic or Common Name of Commodity
description: Every package shall bear the common or generic names of the commodity contained in the package.
english_text: Every package shall bear the common or generic names of the commodity contained in the package.
hindi_text_snippet: प्रत्येक पैकेज पर उसमें निहित वस्तु का सामान्य या जेनेरिक नाम लिखा होना चाहिए।
applicability_notes: Mandatory for all packaged goods to prevent misleading or ambiguous product labeling.

description: Every package shall bear the net quantity, in terms of the standard unit of weight or measure, of the commodity contained in the package or where the commodity is packed or sold by number, the number of the commodity contained in the package.
legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(c) read with Rule 11, 12, 13 and Second Schedule, Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
official_legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(c) read with Rules 11, 12, 13 and Second Schedule, Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
source_pdf: 2023.12.29 Standard Operating Procedure for Edible oil & Fats Net Quantity Measurement signed copy_1732872010.pdf
english_text: Every package shall bear the net quantity, in terms of standard unit of weight or measure or number. For liquid commodities like edible oils and fats, net quantity by weight or volume shall adhere to SOP guidelines.
hindi_text_snippet: प्रत्येक पैकेज पर शुद्ध मात्रा (भार या माप की मानक इकाई या संख्या में) अंकित होनी चाहिए।
applicability_notes: Mandatory for all commodities. Specific SOPs apply for edible oils, fats, liquid produce, and farm produce up to 50 kg.

declaration_name: Month and Year of Manufacture / Pre-packing
description: Every package shall bear the month and the year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported.
official_legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(d), Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (as amended by G.S.R. 784(E))
english_text: Every package shall bear the month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported.
hindi_text_snippet: प्रत्येक पैकेज पर निर्माण या प्री-पैकिंग या आयात का माह और वर्ष स्पष्ट रूप से लिखा होना आवश्यक है।
applicability_notes: Mandatory across all sectors. Extension exemptions granted for specific inventory transitions under 2023 amendments.

declaration_name: Country of Origin for Imported Products
applicability_condition: is_imported == true or country_of_origin is not null
description: For imported packages, the name of the country of origin or manufacture or assembly where the product is manufactured or assembled shall be mentioned on the package.
official_legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(da), Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 & DoCA E-Commerce COO Guidelines
source_pdf: 2026.02.13 PCR 1st COO Filter on e-commerce websites_1771231030.pdf
english_text: For imported packages and products listed on e-commerce platforms, the name of the country of origin or manufacture or assembly shall be explicitly mentioned.
hindi_text_snippet: आयातित वस्तुओं और ई-कॉमर्स वेबसाइटों पर सूचीबद्ध उत्पादों के लिए मूल देश (Country of Origin) का नाम दर्शाना अनिवार्य है।
applicability_notes: Crucial for imported goods and digital/e-commerce marketplaces. Mandatory 1st & 2nd COO filters required on e-commerce product display pages.

description: For imported packages, the name and complete address of the importer must be declared on the package.
legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(da) read with Rule 6(1)(a), Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
official_legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(da) read with Rule 6(1)(a), Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
english_text: For imported packages, the name and complete address of the importer must be declared on the package.
hindi_text_snippet: आयातित पैकेज पर आयातकर्ता का नाम और पूरा पता लिखा जाना अनिवार्य है।
applicability_notes: Mandatory for all imported items sold in India.

description: Every package shall bear the retail sale price of the package in Indian Rupees, inclusive of all taxes, in the prescribed format (e.g. 'MRP Rs. ... incl. of all taxes' or 'MRP ₹ ... incl. of all taxes').
legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(e) read with Rule 2(m), Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
official_legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(e) read with Rule 2(m), Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
english_text: Every package shall bear the retail sale price of the package in Indian Rupees inclusive of all taxes in the format 'MRP Rs. ... incl. of all taxes' or 'MRP ₹ ... incl. of all taxes'.
hindi_text_snippet: प्रत्येक पैकेज पर अधिकतम खुदरा मूल्य (सभी करों सहित) रु. या ₹ के रूप में स्पष्ट रूप से अंकित होना चाहिए।
applicability_notes: Mandatory for all packaged retail goods. Specific price revision guidelines apply to medical devices, pharmaceuticals, and essential commodities.

description: Every package shall bear the name of the person or office who can be contacted in case of consumer complaints along with telephone number, email address, and postal address.
legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(g) read with Rule 6(8), Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
official_legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(g) read with Rule 6(8), Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
english_text: Every package shall bear the name, address, telephone number and email address of the person or office who can be contacted in case of consumer complaints.
hindi_text_snippet: उपभोक्ता शिकायतों के समाधान के लिए संबंधित व्यक्ति या कार्यालय का नाम, पता, टेलीफोन नंबर और ईमेल आईडी पैकेज पर अनिवार्य है।
applicability_notes: Mandatory across all consumer packaged products without exception.

declaration_name: Best Before or Use By Date
applicability_condition: category in ['food', 'perishable', 'cosmetics', 'pharmaceutical'] or best_before_date is not null
description: For commodities which may become unfit for human consumption after a period of time, the 'best before' or 'use by' date, month and year shall be mentioned.
english_text: For commodities which may become unfit for human consumption after a period of time, the 'best before' or 'use by' date, month and year shall be mentioned.
hindi_text_snippet: मानव उपभोग के लिए कालावधि के पश्चात अनुपयुक्त होने वाली वस्तुओं पर 'सर्वश्रेष्ठ उपयोग अवधि' (Best Before) या 'उपयोग तिथि' (Use By) अंकित करना अनिवार्य है।
applicability_notes: Food products, perishable items, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, edible oils, pan masala, and health supplements.

applicability_condition: unit_sale_price is not null or package_type == 'multi_unit'
description: Unit sale price declared in rupees, rounded off to the nearest two decimal places, per g/kg/ml/l/metre/number.
legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(e) clause (ii) & (iii), Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (as amended)
official_legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(e) clause (ii) & (iii), Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (as amended 2021/2022)
english_text: Unit sale price declared in rupees, rounded off to nearest two decimal places, per g/kg/ml/l/metre/number.
hindi_text_snippet: इकाई बिक्री मूल्य (Unit Sale Price) प्रति ग्राम/किग्रा/मिली/लीटर/मीटर/संख्या के आधार पर निकटतम दो दशमलव स्थानों तक अंकित होना चाहिए।
applicability_notes: Multi-unit packages, garments (per piece/number), large volume food items, and packaged retail items exceeding 1 unit/kg/litre.
